selection.note: Screens are descriptive, not significance tests. Retain plausible interactions under pressure. Use paired configurations; do not average unmatched subspaces. FP8 is rejected by runtime despite schema acceptance. Memory ceiling and output ceiling are inactive controls. Runtime reserve is represented by effective L1 capacity. Fixed lengths and output/increment tails have small effects in the tested range and are not expanded.
selection.units: Hit rates are fractions. Axis shared_l3.available_gb is TB; base shared_l3.available_gb is GB. Latencies and think times are ms; link rates GB/s. Seeds and distribution shapes require separate base configurations.

jobs.label: formal-l2-restore
jobs.reason: Resolve restore saturation jointly with available cache capacities and reuse interval; omit already collapsed 0.5 GB/s.

jobs.label: formal-l3-restore
jobs.reason: Capacity and bandwidth interact; retain transition rates and exclude huge-L3 redundant cases.

jobs.label: formal-prefetch
jobs.reason: Gate crosses typical reusable context; evaluate whether suppressing restores helps under a slow link.

jobs.label: formal-page-latency
jobs.reason: Page granularity trades ideal reusable tokens against per-page fixed link service cost.

jobs.label: formal-gpu-pressure
jobs.reason: GPU residence time occupies active L1; probe compute/HBM/concurrency interactions without the already collapsed 250 GB/s HBM corner.

jobs.label: formal-fixed-overheads
jobs.reason: Individually nontrivial communication and kernel costs may accumulate and displace cache from L1.

jobs.label: formal-growth-scheduling
jobs.reason: Long outputs and context growth require pressure-regime verification of otherwise insensitive scheduling knobs.

jobs.label: formal-prompt-tail-05
jobs.reason: Retain equal nominal mean and change tail shape separately from capacity.

jobs.label: formal-prompt-tail-10
jobs.reason: Strong tail doubles mean TTFT in pilots; avoid reducing L1 into a known request-size risk region.

jobs.label: formal-parallelism
jobs.reason: TP/EP and GPU count change both weight/KV placement and performance; do not interpret as pure cache capacity.

jobs.label: formal-rounds-2
jobs.reason: Hold nominal per-instance request rate at 0.2/s; changes root traffic and ideal reuse, so report normalized capture as well as raw hits.

jobs.label: formal-rounds-10
jobs.reason: Same nominal request-rate control as two-round sessions.

jobs.label: formal-boundary-n4000-seed1
jobs.reason: Replicate L3 bandwidth/capacity transition at original horizon.

jobs.label: formal-boundary-n4000-seed2
jobs.reason: Third seed at original horizon; seed 0 is in formal-l3-restore.

jobs.label: formal-boundary-n8000-seed0
jobs.reason: Double offered horizon, preserving request rate, five rounds and think time.
